Travel & Tourism Payment Solutions

Travel & Tourism Payment Solutions

The #1 payment processing solution for the travel sector

Save money on credit card processing fees & avoid account holds due to cancellations and chargebacks.

The #1 payment processing solution for the travel sector

Save money on credit card processing fees & avoid account holds due to cancellations and chargebacks.

Check if you qualify

Travel is considered a high-risk industry for many traditional payment processors – this can lead to account limitations and higher fees for your business.

Chargebacks and fraud pose another risk to your business. They can shrink your profits and place your account at risk of being blacklisted on the Terminated Merchant File (TMF).

As a merchant account industry leader with years of experience, TailoredPay can help you avoid these problems, protect your business and even reduce your current processing fees! Complete our simple pre-approval form to see if you qualify!

✓ No Setup Fees
✓ Industry Minimum Rates
✓ Daily Settlements

Our Solution

TailoredPay specializes in helping travel & tourism companies to process payments. We have an extensive global network of processing partners, allowing all types of businesses to succeed.

  • Fast & simple online application

  • High approval rate

  • No setup or application fees

  • 20+ High-risk merchant solutions
